day_local: Ataaniup Sapaataata Inulinginnut Aqqutaanut Aippiata Ullua
greeting: Atataup, Ilualu, Takkialu Aqqani. Quana Ataniq Jesus Christ, katimajuq ilissinni.
penitential:
Ataniq, nalligitigut.
Christ, nalligitigut.
Ataniq, nalligitigut.
homily:
Ataaniup aqqutingani. Qivgaqtut, tusaajavut Galatians-mi uqausiinik: 'I am amazed that you are so quickly forsaking the one who called you by the grace of Christ for a different gospel.' Qivgaqtuq Paul uqaqtuq uqumaittumik, uummammi iluani. Takugitsi sarpik, sarpik aqqut. Aqqut ungahiktumut piumanngilaq. Inuk apqutimi pisuktuq, ilani kinguiniklu qaitillugu. Benjamin Vo, 15-nik ukiuqaqtilluni, qaujimajurli qanuq aqqutiqaqtilluni. Ben qaujimajurli qanuq aviation-mi, Boeing 737-mi, ammalu qanuq 'con chim airlines'-mik qajjaalauqtuq, giggles-pallalauqtuq dad-mut. Ben-up inuusia, taanna 'masterpiece-ngulluni', uummataup salumajunianik ammalu asijinik asujinik tatatitaulluni.

Tusaajavut Gospel-mi, Luke-mi, tusaajavut qanuq scholar-up uqaqtillugu: 'And who is my neighbor?' Jesus-up uqaqtuq Samaritan-up uqausiinik. Samaritan, inuk aannialuqtumik takujuq, qanuq qajjaalauqtuq. Oil and wine pour-laurpuq wounds-nut, bandaged-laurpuq, liff-laurpuq animal-mit, inn-mut isirlu. 'Which of these three, in your opinion, was neighbor to the robbers' victim?' The one who treated him with mercy. Jesus said to him, 'Go and do likewise.'

Alan, Thao, ammalu Ryan. Ilissiklu uqumaittumik atuqtut. Qaujimajavut uqumaittuq, qaujimajavut silataani inuusiq. Kisiani, uqaqtuq Gospel-mi, 'Go and do likewise.' Ben, taanna 'Banquet of Heaven'-mi, standing beside Saint Carlo Acutis. Two brilliant, modern boys who loved technology, who loved the world, but who loved God more. They are not dead; they are more alive than we are. They are soaring in the light of the Father, free from all weight, breathing the pure air of heaven. Ben's legacy continues to flow on earth, like the clean, life-sustaining water from the 'Giếng Gioan Baotixita' well dedicated in his name in Cà Mau, Vietnam. His middle name, Đại Dương—Great Ocean—remains a sign of God's limitless mercy flowing to those in need.

What can we carry out the door today? When your heart feels heavy, when the morning light comes in and you feel the empty chair, do not look only at the silence. Look up at the sky, just like Ben loved to watch airplanes soar, and remember that God's peace is real, God's covenant is forever, and Benjamin Vo is safe in the Father's eternal embrace.
spiritual_communion: Ataniq Jesus, upperivunga Illit Santus-mi Sacrament-mi. Asigivagit piumajunga inuusigalu iluani. Maannauvaktuq ihuigijunga takunninngikkaluarlunga Illit uummammi. Tikisirlu ilualu ilissinni. Aasii nalliusirniatillunga illinni piumajuq. Aulanialluinnarnanga illinit. Amen.
closing: Ataniup piqutini illinniittuq. Illigutlu qaiqqunanga inuusirmik quviasuttuq.
standing_petitions: Benjamin Vo-mut ammalu tamarmik inungnut qianngittunut, qulliqsiorniatillugu Ataniup light-ani.
Tamarmik uqumaittumik atuqtunut, Ataniq qaitillugu quviasukniq ammalu upperneq.

readings.label: First Reading
readings.text: Brothers and sisters: I am amazed that you are so quickly forsaking the one who called you by the grace of Christ for a different gospel (not that there is another). But there are some who are disturbing you and wish to pervert the Gospel of Christ. But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach to you a gospel other than the one that we preached to you, let that one be accursed! As we have said before, and now I say again, if anyone preaches to you a gospel other than the one that you received, let that one be accursed! Am I now currying favor with human beings or God? Or am I seeking to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a slave of Christ. Now I want you to know, brothers and sisters, that the Gospel preached by me is not of human origin. For I did not receive it from a human being, nor was I taught it, but it came through a revelation of Jesus Christ.

readings.label: Responsorial Psalm
readings.text:
R. The Lord will remember his covenant for ever.
I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the company and assembly of the just. Great are the works of the LORD, exquisite in all their delights.
R. The Lord will remember his covenant for ever.
The works of his hands are faithful and just; sure are all his precepts, Reliable forever and ever, wrought in truth and equity.
R. The Lord will remember his covenant for ever.
He has sent deliverance to his people; he has ratified his covenant forever; holy and awesome is his name. His praise endures forever.
R. The Lord will remember his covenant for ever.

readings.label: Gospel
readings.text: There was a scholar of the law who stood up to test Jesus and said, “Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?” Jesus said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?” He said in reply, “You shall love the Lord, your God, with all your heart, with all your being, with all your strength, and with all your mind, and your neighbor as yourself.” He replied to him, “You have answered correctly; do this and you will live.” But because he wished to justify himself, he said to Jesus, “And who is my neighbor?” Jesus replied, “A man fell victim to robbers as he went down from Jerusalem to Jericho. They stripped and beat him and went off leaving him half-dead. A priest happened to be going down that road, but when he saw him, he passed by on the opposite side. Likewise a Levite came to the place, and when he saw him, he passed by on the opposite side. But a Samaritan traveler who came upon him was moved with compassion at the sight. He approached the victim, poured oil and wine over his wounds and bandaged them. Then he lifted him up on his own animal, took him to an inn, and cared for him. The next day he took out two silver coins and gave them to the innkeeper with the instruction, ‘Take care of him. If you spend more than what I have given you, I shall repay you on my way back.’ Which of these three, in your opinion, was neighbor to the robbers’ victim?” He answered, “The one who treated him with mercy.” Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”

day: Monday of the Twenty-seventh Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.
